ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; approximately 5-8% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white markings against a 92-95% dark charcoal/black field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark low-intensity field with discrete high-contrast white geometric clusters. Markings include circular rosette outlines (0.05-0.1 fluke-width diameter) on both lobes, parallel linear arrays (rake marks) on the medial-left and distal-right regions, and dense, irregular white mottling at the outer fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge features four distinct triangular notches (2-3% fluke-width depth). Right lobe trailing edge exhibits a major semi-circular excision (approx. 5% depth) near the distal tip and a jagged, high-frequency serration pattern throughout.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to an increasingly sharp distal taper at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast circular rings; three distinct rosettes on the left lobe (upper quadrant) and two prominent rosettes on the right lobe (central quadrant).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of parallel linear pixel disruptions. A prominent set of four parallel vertical streaks is visible on the left lobe; multiple intersecting diagonal sets are visible on the distal half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss (major notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip; extensive white linear scarring (rake marks) across the entirety of both lobes; dense white scar tissue clusters at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, labyrinthine white scarring patterns localized at the furthest lateral extensions of both the left and right flukes.
